title: AI persuading AI vs AI persuading Humans: LLMs’ Differential Effectiveness in Promoting Pro-Environmental Behavior

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing pre- and post-intervention attitudinal and behavioral changes between real humans, simulated humans, and fully synthetic personas using OLS regression and Pearson correlations to quantify how much LLM-based agents overestimate the effectiveness of persuasion strategies.

Analyzing self-reported baseline and post-intervention pro-environmental behaviors to detect inflated compliance and artificially high behavioral reporting in LLM-generated synthetic participants compared to actual human responses.
